properties.NAME: Oklahoma Terr.
properties.CHANGE: GREER became a county in Oklahoma Territory following the U.S. Supreme Court ruling of 16 Mar. 1896 that determined GREER was not within the boundaries of the state of Texas. Map depicts non-county area in Okla. Terr.
properties.CITATION: ("United States v. Texas," in U.S. Rpts., 162:1-91; U.S. Stat., vol. 29, ch. 155[1896]/pp. 113-114; U.S.Stat., vol. 29, ch. 155 [1896]/ p. 113; Van Zandt, 122, 140; Morris, 123-124)
